deliberateDepartures.description: Used common palette roles instead of original reference and scheme sample colors, as required. Pale surfaces use opacity of the semantic roles over white. Scaled corner radii and typography to each actual CSS slot; no repeating pattern because the briefs do not describe patterned ground.
Both B and C receive matching accent treatments because both seats are equally selectable; one accent destination would suggest a false preference.
Wrapped the two long role labels without omitting characters. Routed the warning return separately from the main downward handoff.
Accent marks the completed review rather than the unreached publication destination, to avoid implying publication is already complete.
Used a broad empty box silhouette rather than the scheme chair motif because the specified empty object is a return box.
